purpose: Runtime modular resource district sprite kits
rights: Original project-generated artwork, text-only prompts; no third-party image inputs.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original modular SPRITE ATLAS for an isometric fantasy game. Output exactly 1536x1024 pixels, a regular invisible 3 column x 2 row grid of six 512x512 cells. Exactly one complete isolated object CENTERED IN EACH CELL, generous completely transparent margins in each cell, no objects touching or overlapping adjacent cells. True transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, square tile, landscape, backing, labels, text, numbers, watermark or grid lines. Soft compact semitransparent contact shadow only directly under each object.
Style: hand-painted CARTOON 2D game sprites with broad readable softly rounded painted volumes, warm dark-brown contour accents, gentle upper-left highlights, restrained detail. Fixed orthographic isometric camera 55 degrees above ground horizon, show top and front, feet/base toward bottom of image. Cohesive fantasy materials, NOT photorealism, pixel art, clay or low-poly 3D. These are reusable individual modular objects, NOT one finished scenery picture. All six cells are DISTINCT healthy conifers matching olive/yellow-green upper foliage and dark cool-green undersides, warm brown short trunks with roots. Top row: one tall narrow wind-bent fir; one broad asymmetrical mature tiered fir; one medium two-trunk dense conifer. Bottom row: one short rounder bushy young fir; one tall irregular sparse fir with several visible branch gaps; one compact triangular young conifer. Each is a SINGLE independent tree with different silhouette and bough layout; keep each centered and complete. No cut lumber, buildings, rocks, decorations or other tree species.
